data.body: **[P1] Rebind raw operation errors at the target boundary.** Non-envelope failures have no stored source context, so this guard returns errors from standard invokes, callbacks, or disabled operation offloaders unchanged. They consequently bypass the root offloader and may expose data inline or exceed response limits. Require source context only for envelopes; offload raw serialized error data directly under the execution `EXCEPTION` context. Apply the same rule in `SerializableDurableOperation.rebindForwardedError` for child checkpoints and add raw/disabled-error coverage.
